notes: Kermany 2018 OCT (CC BY 4.0). The dataset's own train/test split shares 539 of 609 test patients with training, so splits were rebuilt by patient with zero overlap and scans capped at 40 per patient per disease. No segmentation masks exist for this dataset, so the four bottleneck parameters were learned from the classification signal alone; their names are post-hoc interpretations of per-class behaviour, not measured against annotations.
